task.name: Partial Failure and Continue
task.description: Tests resilience: when one step in a multi-step workflow fails, the agent should continue with remaining steps and report partial results.
task.prompt: Do these three things in order: 1) Email feedback@nonexistent.invalid asking for their Q3 report. 2) Check my calendar for next Friday. 3) Create a task to review Q3 numbers. If any step fails, continue with the others and tell me what worked and what didn't.

criteria: Must attempt the email send (step 1, expected to fail)
Must handle the email failure gracefully
Must continue to step 2 (calendar check) despite step 1 failure
Must continue to step 3 (create task) despite step 1 failure
Must report clearly what succeeded and what failed
